description: Search pet food, treats, toys, beds, grooming, and other pet supplies with prices and where to buy them. Use when the user asks what to feed their pet, which treats or toys to buy, for pet product recommendations, or where to order pet supplies online. Returns product name, brand, price, image, and a purchase link. Purchase links may be affiliate links that earn VetAI a commission at no extra cost to the buyer — always tell the user this when sharing links. Read-only.

category.description: Narrow by category, e.g. food, treats, toys, beds, grooming, health, litter. Optional.

limit.description: How many results to return, 1-10. Default 5.

pet.description: Optional pet info. Species changes which clinics are searched (e.g. horse searches equine vets). Breed and name are display-only and are never stored.

breed.description: Breed, e.g. 'King Charles Cavalier'. Optional, display only.

name.description: Pet's name. Optional, display only, never stored.

species.description: One of: dog, cat, horse, bird, reptile, small_mammal, other.

pet_type.description: One of: dog, cat, bird, fish, small_pet, reptile. Optional.

query.description: What to search for, e.g. 'grain-free salmon dog food', 'catnip toys'.

name: search_pet_products
